title: Cut the towel in half?
hook: Two half towels hung flat, or one whole one. Which has more face to dry?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that splitting a flat sheet keeps the same total face area, so two halves hung flat dry no faster than the whole towel hung flat

misconception: Cutting a towel in half and hanging both halves doubles its drying surface.
objective: Splitting a flat rectangle preserves the combined front-and-back face area. It adds edges, but does not double the large faces; separating folded layers is a different operation.

recall.question: A flat 80 × 120 cm sheet, fully exposed, is cut into two 80 × 60 cm halves. What happens to the total face area?
recall.why: Each half has half the face area, so together they match the original: 2 × 0.8 × 1.2 = 1.92 m² either way. Cutting adds edges; only opening a folded sheet reveals hidden faces.
